A2 GRAMMAR ADVENTURE

While the Cat Was Sleeping…

Past Continuous & Past Simple — built for Ivan ✨

⏱ 90 minutes🎯 Past Continuous + Past Simple🎲 Dice game🎧 Real listening
⏱ 5 min Warm-up

Hi Ivan! 👋

Yesterday at 8 o'clock, six friends and a sleepy cat were very busy. Let's find out what everyone was doing!

Today you'll become a time detective 🕵️. You will learn how to talk about two kinds of past:

1. Actions that were happening (still going on) → Past Continuous
2. Actions that finished (done, complete) → Past Simple

🤔 Quick think (say it out loud)

Look at these two sentences. What is the difference?

A. Last night I watched a film. (the whole film — finished)
B. At 9 o'clock I was watching a film. (in the middle of it — in progress)
💡 Sentence B is a snapshot — like a photo taken during the action. That's the Past Continuous. Let's learn it!
⏱ 20 min Presentation

📚 Part 1 — Past Continuous

An action that was in progress at a moment in the past.

subject + was / were + verb + ‑ing
Subjectwas / wereexample
I / He / She / ItwasShe was sleeping.
You / We / TheywereThey were playing.

Negatives & Questions

TypeFormExample
➖ Negativewasn't / weren't + ‑ingHe wasn't reading.
❓ QuestionWas/Were + subject + ‑ing?Was Bob sleeping?
✅ Short answerYes, … was/were. / No, … wasn't/weren't.Yes, he was.

✏️ Spelling: how to add ‑ing

RuleExample
Normal → + ingplay → playing
‑e → drop e, + ingmake → making
short vowel + 1 consonant → double itsit → sitting, run → running
Presentation

⏳ Part 2 — The two pasts together

This is the magic rule. Watch the timeline! ⬇️

"I was watching TV when the phone rang."

📺 I was watching TV (long action, in progress)
📞 rang!
past
now

Past Continuous = the longer action already happening (the background).
Past Simple = the short action that suddenly happens and interrupts it. 💥

🔑 WHEN + Past Simple  |  WHILE + Past Continuous
• I was cooking when the lights went off.
• While I was cooking, the lights went off.
(Same meaning — just two ways to say it!)

🎬 Interactive timeline — press play

Click the button and watch the long action get interrupted!

🍳 was cooking…
💥 burned!
💡 Memory trick for Ivan: Continuous = camera filming 🎥 (it keeps going). Simple = a photo flash 📸 (one quick click).

⏱ 7 min Practice 2

✍️ B. Build the Past Continuous

Type the verb in the ‑ing form. Watch your spelling!

1 They were a board game. (play)
2 The cat was on my book. (sit — double the t!)
3 Mum was a cake. (make — drop the e!)
4 We were in the park. (run)
5 He was a comic. (read)
⏱ 8 min Practice 3

⚡ C. Which past? Continuous or Simple?

The long action gets Past Continuous. The short action that interrupts gets Past Simple. Choose!

1 I when you called me.
2 While we were waiting, the bus .
3 It when I left the house.
4 He was playing football when he his leg.
⏱ 5 min Practice 4

🔗 D. while or when?

while goes before the long action (‑ing). when goes before the short, finished action.

1 I was sleeping, the storm started.
2 She was cooking the phone rang.
3 They saw a fox they were walking home.

⏱ 8 min Practice 6 · Exercise 9

❓ Make the questions

Use the prompts to write Past Continuous questions, then check the model. Say them out loud with your teacher (A & B)!

1 Bob / sleep?
A: Was Bob sleeping?   B: Yes, he was.
2 Frank and Beth / sit on the sofa?
A: Were Frank and Beth sitting on the sofa?   B: No, they weren't.
3 Frank / listen to music?
A: Was Frank listening to music?   B: Yes, he was.
4 Beth / play a board game?
A: Was Beth playing a board game?   B: No, she wasn't.
5 Kate / talk on the phone?
A: Was Kate talking on the phone?   B: Yes, she was.
🗣️ Pair work: You are A, your teacher is B. Ask the question, get the short answer — then swap!

🗣️ Tell me about YOU, Ivan!

Answer in real Past Continuous sentences. Speak — don't write!

1. What were you doing yesterday at twelve o'clock?
e.g. "I was eating lunch."
2. What were you doing yesterday at 8 o'clock in the evening?
3. What were your family doing when you woke up this morning?

📝 3 things to remember:
1️⃣ Past Continuous = was/were + ‑ing (action in progress 🎥)
2️⃣ Past Simple = finished action (one quick flash 📸)
3️⃣ while + ‑ing   /   when + finished action
